meta.title: eRFX project level (all stages), one clause Required: the vendor accepts only the Required clause
gaps: The case's claim that project-level clauses are asked on every stage cannot be observed because the requested setup contains only one RFQ stage; no catalog step can compare the clauses across multiple stages.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The case's claim that project-level clauses are asked on every stage cannot be observed because the requested setup contains only one RFQ stage; no catalog step can compare the clauses across multiple stages.

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Set the required project title.
Configure the project with the requested RFQ-only stage.
Apply RFQ-specific configuration on the RFQ tab.
Select the first offered RFQ template.
Add one CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.

args.goal: On the RFQ create screen, set the line item's delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set Payment within 45 days to Required, leave Delivery within 7 days at None, and click Done; stop with the saved project-level terms visible or otherwise proven saved.

steps.note: Configure the delivery location and project-level required/optional clauses, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor as required for the vendor-side submission.
Publish the RFQ event.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify that the required project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify that the optional project-level clause is also shown.
Have the vendor accept the required clause.
Ensure the optional clause remains unaccepted.
Quote 100 for the line and submit; successful submission demonstrates that the unaccepted optional clause does not block bidding.
Verify that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
